problem_and_intended_users_defined.rationale: The product defines a narrow maintainer/contributor problem: repeatable public-documentation link validation without turning repository-controlled URLs into a private-network probe or reimplementing a mature link checker.

public_repository_or_distribution_surfac.rationale: P-048 is distributed publicly as a reusable GitHub composite Action and a non-draft v0.5.0 release.

explicit_open_source_license.rationale: The public proving-ground repository contains the MIT License covering the P-048 source.

complete_readme.rationale: Product-scoped documentation covers purpose, least-privilege use, PASS/FAIL/ERROR semantics, SSRF/supply-chain/privacy design, recovery, accessibility, localization path, support, false positives and limitations.

beginner_start_here_path.rationale: A dedicated beginner path explains what the scanner does, minimal GitHub Actions use, meaning of results, private-network protection, recovery and privacy-safe support.

engineering_or_architecture_documentatio.rationale: Architecture documents upstream adoption, SSRF trust boundary, supply-chain pinning, fixed network policy, bounded local input, privacy-minimized evidence, permissions, result semantics and rollback.

reproducible_installation_or_use_instruc.rationale: Consumers can invoke public @v0.5.0 on GitHub-hosted Linux x64; the Action itself locks Lychee 0.24.2 to official Linux x64 archive SHA-256 1f4e0ef7f6554a6ed33dd7ac144fb2e1bbed98598e7af973042fc5cd43951c9a and exposes no moving latest dependency.

safety_scope_and_limitations.rationale: The product explicitly limits PASS to link reachability/reference validity for the bounded scanned scope and excludes destination correctness/security, documentation correctness/completeness, accessibility conformance, private-link coverage and future availability claims.

recovery_or_rollback_guidance_for_mutati.rationale: P-048 is non-mutating. Incomplete results are discarded and rerun against unchanged input; consumers can roll back by pinning a prior reviewed Action ref or removing the workflow invocation.

tests_and_ci.rationale: Adversarial and hosted tests cover public/local positive links, broken local links, byte immutability, path/resource bounds, loopback/cloud-metadata/private-address/credential refusal, exact Lychee supply-chain hash, governed release, exact-tag verification and released-ref real-public consumption.

security_and_privacy_review.rationale: The review covers SSRF/private-network probing, GitHub-hosted-only execution, static and request-time private-address exclusion, no arbitrary scanner args/auth headers/tokens, archive integrity/traversal checks, bounded inputs, raw-URL evidence minimization and privacy-safe support intake.

accessibility_review.rationale: The non-graphical developer Action exposes plain-text status plus stable machine outputs without color-only or pointer-dependent operation. This is an applicability review, not WCAG conformance or human assistive-technology acceptance.

multilingual_path_considered.rationale: Stable status/count/hash outputs are language-neutral integration keys and human workflow explanation can be localized independently; v0.5.0 documentation is English-first and multilingual user acceptance is not claimed.

real_world_acceptance_test.rationale: The public @v0.5.0 Action passed against a real public learning-git checkout without README mutation and independently refused the real public Kimi-Haul documentation scope containing an explicit localhost URL, proving the release both works and preserves its private-target boundary.

evidence_retained.rationale: Release-plan, publication and released-ref public-consumer evidence are retained with exact artifact IDs/digests, while permanent release/completion documentation records their meaning and limitations without retaining raw URLs.

version_tag_or_release_published.rationale: Public non-draft v0.5.0 was published on 2026-08-16 and independent workflow verification resolved the public tag to exact product source 1cc9cb51539e7e39e7141d994d9ad1709c71fece.

known_limitations_documented.rationale: GitHub-hosted Linux x64 scope, public unauthenticated URLs only, no arbitrary Lychee configuration, transient-site false positives, no auto-fix and all destination/documentation/accessibility/security non-claims are explicit.

contribution_and_issue_paths.rationale: General contribution guidance and a dedicated privacy-safe P-048 support/reproduction form exist, including explicit instructions not to publish private URLs, credentials or proprietary documentation.

canonical_handover_or_build_record_updat.rationale: The final completion tranche binds architecture, upstream identity, supply-chain hash, governed release, exact public tag source, real public positive and safety-negative consumers, retained evidence, limitations and completion semantics in auditable records; governing DAIS portfolio synchronization remains a post-merge promotion step and cannot weaken this product record.
